interpretation.air: Apparent output decay includes room/capture. Stable screen is diagnostic, not a confidence interval. Intrinsic84.68Hz pole is distinct from rendered99Hz component. No global gain change.
interpretation.open_tones: 165Hz dominates Eastman finger difference; removing it reverses reference-minus-model median to -2.93dB. This projection is not proof of weak sympathetic coupling.
interpretation.scores: Small flat-top improvements and approximately0.6% archtop regressions are descriptor changes, not listener realism ratings.
interpretation.headroom: Checks preserve existing policy: +-1LU parity and up to0.9LU Pick sacrifice. Hardest simultaneous-channel chords still hit limiter; no claim that every construction avoids it.

callback_benchmark.scope: native DSP including MIDI noteOns; excludes JUCE and host overhead
callback_benchmark.ordering: baseline first on even trials, current first on odd trials
callback_benchmark.setup: fresh engine prepared before each timed callback
callback_benchmark.named_model_comparison: matching named models on both adapters
callback_benchmark.compiler_flags: c++ -std=c++20 -O3 -DNDEBUG -arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=11.0; matching namespace-renamed adapters, no LTO or fast-math
callback_benchmark.scope_note: No concurrent tool builds/rendering during measurement. Native noteOn+process only, zeroCC2, excludes host and Performer. All timed observations preserved.
